resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says Grattan. The statewide list uses Moose Lake as the row label and also gives Moose Lake-Grattan. Both sit at nearly the same coordinates, so we treat them as one site.
The statewide list has a tentative note placing a possible lookout near Coddington Lake, northwest of Dora, with no coordinates. We follow the Moose Lake location that matches the FFLA coordinates.

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers, A-Z List

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both lists. The statewide list gives 'erected before 1941' and no height, type or build year. The Coddington Lake note is tentative and has no coordinates. No removal date and no description of the site today. The Carlton County Moose Lake tower is a different structure and should not be mixed up with this record. Possible follow-up: Itasca County and Minnesota DNR forestry records, and Itasca County newspaper archives.
